udp_like_status.authority: current-head OpenWrt fullstack + packet/first-arrival gates + game/settings matrices + ADR-0010 release freeze
udp_like_status.outer_semantics: WBD-owned TCP-shaped raw carrier with earliest-complete inner datagram delivery; platform TCP reliability remains above WBD. Game lanes are independent outer associations rather than duplicate ciphertext in one flow.
udp_like_status.fec_status: Release wire path remains off or fixed systematic 20:20 unless an explicit future ADR changes it. Research formula can evaluate 20:4/8/12/16/20 and 10:10; 10:10 remains research-only. Current simulation evidence shows 10:10 can reduce recovery latency but is materially weaker than 20:20 under burst loss.
udp_like_status.capacity_policy: ADR-0010 release authority remains 40 Mbit/s aggregate inner on <=100 Mbit/s physical weak-link qualification. New 5..150 Mbit/s discovery work is for formula/recommendation calibration and must not silently reopen the release cap.
udp_like_status.link_speed_policy: Two authorities exist: auto and manual. Manual must work with no auto sample and force the configured capacity. Auto estimates service capacity separately from loss/burst; do not equate high-loss application goodput with physical link speed. Runtime research uses packet arrival dispersion/delivery samples plus independent loss/burst statistics.
udp_like_status.game_mode: User-selectable 1..4 lanes. Optional auto-add-lane may raise lane count up to configured max but game mode does not downgrade into FEC-only mode. Logical inner pacing occurs before replication and inner ceiling accounts for active lane replication plus actual wire/FEC/carrier expansion. Each lane must look like a distinct outer traffic flow via independent association/ticket/LiveID/DTLS/FakeTCP tuple and sequence space.
udp_like_status.platform_status: OpenWrt clean fullstack one-shot is green, including DNS/UDP/TCP, full-cone EIM/EIF, hairpin loopback, bidirectional underlay escape and cleanup. Windows Wintun device, route lifecycle and real bidirectional admin dataplane are green; full Windows WBD composition is not yet green because Windows DTLS build is red.

product_policy.link_setup: Reality-like TLS front remains setup/admission only; sustained payload remains WBD FakeTCP -> pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> immutable LINK.
product_policy.accounts: One shared username/password may authenticate multiple simultaneous devices; routing/session state is ticket/LiveID/peer keyed, never username keyed.
product_policy.fullcone_nat: OpenWrt UDP is endpoint-independent mapping plus endpoint-independent filtering and has a root-qualified hairpin/NAT-loopback gate. This is platform behavior, not transport semantics.
product_policy.windows_gui: Windows product requires a native GUI. Minimize and window-close hide to the system tray and keep VPN running; tray restores the window; explicit Disconnect stops the tunnel; explicit Exit performs cleanup then terminates. Explorer/taskbar restart must restore the tray icon. GUI must call a runtime controller rather than embed transport logic in the UI thread.
product_policy.settings_testing: Every exposed game/link-speed/FEC/lane/pacing setting must have executable validation. Current game-settings-matrix and game-lane-fullstack are green on d548a9488c39f7a4109347c883c53c693bd807c6.
